name: Repeated MFA Denial or Timeout Followed by Successful Authentication
window: 15 minutes ending at the successful authentication
platform: Sentinel KQL; Splunk approximation; generic evaluator

name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Executing SYSTEM PowerShell
window: Task/process correlation window; implementation-specific starting point 5 minutes
threshold: No count threshold; either suspicious task definition or suspicious follow-on chain

name: High-Confidence or Correlated SQL Injection Activity
unit: HTTP transaction or source IP + host burst
threshold: >=2 SQLi rules in one transaction, specialist SQLi rule, OR >=20 distinct transactions / 5m
confidence: High for multi-rule; Medium-High for burst
platform: Sentinel KQL; Splunk SPL; Elastic ES|QL; generic evaluator

name: Credential Addition Followed by Service-Principal Sign-In
threshold: One credential addition followed by one successful sign-in using same stable identifiers
confidence: High when both stable IDs are present
attack: Rule-level mapping requires environment review; no inherited scenario mapping used
platform: Sentinel KQL; Splunk SPL; Elastic ES|QL; generic evaluator

name: Privileged Security Group Membership Addition
threshold: One 4728/4732/4756-equivalent event targeting governed privileged group identity
confidence: High when group SID/object ID is available

name: Structured Chunked Data Transfer Over DNS
threshold: >=5 unique structured chunk indexes after exact-event deduplication
confidence: Medium-High; completion marker raises confidence only
